C0630.title: Third-Party Materials Summarizing AliExpress Duplicate Listing Standards
C0630.summary: Around 2021, third-party seller-operation materials from ESG Cross-Border and Maijia summarized AliExpress duplicate listing rules, stating that the platform usually assesses similarity across product main images, titles, attributes, prices, and packaging configurations. These materials note that identical main images with similar titles and attributes, different images with highly similar titles, attributes, and prices, or publishing the same product in too many packaging variants may be treated as duplicate listing.
